title: M3 Open Action Runtime v1 source acceptance

criteria.text: Agent can ObserveActVerify on fixture/replay without an app capability
Requests and results satisfy Canonical Schema
Durable idempotency reservation happens before side effects
Ambiguous actions are not blindly retried
Control Plane restart recovers executing actions to AMBIGUOUS
Agent Gateway does not bypass Control Plane
CLI is non-interactive for DSH/Codex harnesses
Legacy capability lane has no new intended failures
Real device, ADB, and 22222 call counts remain 0
